note_en: Look at 以柔克刚 "use softness to overcome hardness" and 以慢为主 "take slowness as the main thing." 以 A 为 B, "take A as B," and 以 A + verb, "use A to...," are formal, slightly classical patterns. You'll meet them constantly in writing about tradition and philosophy, so learn to recognize the frame: 以…为主 means "mainly...," as in 饮食以清淡为主 "the diet is mainly light food."
